pages.title: Autumn Leaves with Maple and Oak Shapes Coloring Page
pages.description: Four autumn leaves fill this printable coloring page, combining pointed maple lobes, rounded oak edges, and two elongated leaf shapes with clearly outlined stems. Branching veins divide the broad leaf interiors into separate sections, while the loose arrangement leaves white space between the different silhouettes.

pages.title: Smiling Maple Leaf with Branching Veins Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling maple leaf fills this printable coloring page, with pointed lobes, a long curved stem, raised eyebrows, and a wide outlined mouth. Several branching veins extend across the leaf around the face, leaving broad areas between the central stem and the jagged outer edge.

pages.title: Smiling Oak Leaves and Three Acorns Coloring Page
pages.description: Two smiling oak leaves appear above three acorns in this printable coloring page, with rounded leaf lobes, short stems, and patterned acorn caps. Each acorn has a separate outlined face and a curved stalk, while simple branching veins divide the larger leaves into open sections.

pages.title: Autumn Tree with Falling Maple Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: An autumn tree spreads its branches across this printable coloring page, with maple-shaped leaves in the canopy and several more drifting around its trunk. Long bark lines follow the widening base, and a pile of overlapping leaves rests among exposed roots beneath the rounded crown.

pages.title: Winding Path Through an Autumn Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: A winding path leads through an autumn forest in this printable coloring page, passing between broad tree trunks, leafy crowns, and scattered fallen leaves. Larger trees frame both sides of the scene, while smaller trees and rounded bushes mark the distant bend beyond the open foreground.

pages.title: Child Kneeling in a Pumpkin Patch Coloring Page
pages.description: A child kneels among pumpkins in this printable coloring page, wearing a broad hat and overalls while resting both hands against a large pumpkin. A hay bale and wooden fence stand behind the patch, and curling vines with broad leaves connect the pumpkins across the foreground.

pages.title: Scarecrow with Patched Clothes and Corn Coloring Page
pages.description: A scarecrow stands between corn stalks in this printable coloring page, with a patched hat, buttoned shirt, tied belt, and straw-filled sleeves and trousers. Its outstretched arms and hanging trouser legs surround a central support pole, while broad corn leaves and outlined kernels add details on either side.

pages.title: Cornucopia with Autumn Fruit and Corn Coloring Page
pages.description: A large cornucopia fills this printable coloring page, holding apples, a pear, corn, grapes, and small pumpkins beneath the curved opening of its horn. Wide bands follow the curling basket shape, while overlapping leaves and separate fruit outlines create smaller sections around the broad foreground produce.

pages.title: Harvest Stand with Pumpkins and Apples Coloring Page
pages.description: A harvest stand fills this printable coloring page, displaying pumpkins and a basket of apples beneath a scalloped canopy and a row of triangular bunting. Corn stalks frame the stall, while stacked hay bales and a large pumpkin sit in front of its simple wooden counter.

pages.title: Girl Picking Apples with a Harvest Basket Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl picks an apple in this printable coloring page, reaching toward a low branch while holding a small basket filled with more apples. Her overalls, rolled cuffs, and shoes have broad outlined sections, with the tree trunk and a few bushes completing the orchard setting.

pages.title: Basket of Apples with an Autumn Leaf Coloring Page
pages.description: A basket of apples fills this printable coloring page, showing a tall curved handle, broad woven bands, and several apples with short stems and leaves. Two loose apples and an autumn leaf sit in front, adding separate shapes beneath the larger basket and its overlapping fruit.

pages.title: Girl with a Lattice Apple Pie and Apples Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl rests her cheeks above an apple pie in this printable coloring page, with a large plate and two whole apples below her. Broad pastry strips form a lattice across the round pie, while its crimped edge, the girl's bow, and her collar provide smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Girl Holding a Caramel Apple on a Stick Coloring Page
pages.description: A kneeling girl holds a caramel apple in this printable coloring page, gripping its long stick with both hands beside a whole apple and leaf. The outlined coating drips over the top of the apple, while her bow, overalls, folded legs, and shoes remain clearly separated.

pages.title: Girl Holding a Slice of Pumpkin Pie Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl holds a plate of pumpkin pie in this printable coloring page, presenting a large slice topped with whipped cream beside a whole pumpkin. The triangular filling, broad crust, and oval plate create clear layers, with her bow, apron, sleeves, and hands framing the dessert.

pages.title: Girl Holding a Pumpkin Spice Latte Coloring Page
pages.description: A girl holds a pumpkin spice latte in this printable coloring page, sitting with crossed legs beside a pumpkin and two outlined cinnamon sticks. Her mug has a pumpkin emblem, whipped topping, and rising steam, while her pompom hat, ribbed sweater cuffs, and laced shoes add separate clothing details.

pages.title: Fall Leaf Wreath with Acorns and a Bow Coloring Page
pages.description: A fall wreath circles the center of this printable coloring page, combining maple and oak leaves, acorns, round berries, and a large ribbon bow. The leaves overlap around an open white middle, with branching veins and small cap patterns adding details inside the larger decorative shapes.

pages.title: Fall Gnome in a Pointed Hat with a Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: A fall gnome holds a pumpkin in this printable coloring page, wearing a tall pointed hat decorated with a leaf above a large outlined beard. Both hands wrap around the pumpkin, while a buckled belt, rolled boot cuffs, and fallen leaves complete the full standing figure.

pages.title: Owl Perched Among Falling Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: An owl perches on a branch in this printable coloring page, surrounded by falling autumn leaves beneath a smaller branch with two pointed leaves. Its folded wings have broad feather sections, and the outlined beak, gripping feet, and long tail feathers create distinct shapes around the rounded body.

pages.title: Fox Sitting Beneath an Autumn Branch Coloring Page
pages.description: A fox sits beneath an autumn branch in this printable coloring page, with pointed ears, a broad chest patch, four visible paws, and a bushy tail. The tail has a separate outlined tip, while large fallen leaves and the small leafy branch frame the complete seated figure.

pages.title: Squirrel Holding an Acorn with a Curled Tail Coloring Page
pages.description: A squirrel holds an acorn in this printable coloring page, standing on two rear feet with a large curled tail rising beside its body. The acorn has an outlined cap and short stem, while rounded front paws, tufted ears, and scattered oak leaves add smaller recognizable details.

pages.title: Hedgehog Beside Mushrooms and Fall Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A hedgehog stands beside two mushrooms in this printable coloring page, with a rounded face, four short paws, and a back covered in outlined spines. Large autumn leaves lie across the foreground, and the mushrooms show separate caps, spots, stalks, and broad gill sections beneath their edges.

pages.title: Deer Standing Beneath an Autumn Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A deer stands beneath an autumn tree in this printable coloring page, showing small antlers, large ears, outlined back spots, and four complete legs. A short raised tail and pointed chest fur distinguish the animal, while broad fallen leaves and rounded bushes surround the open clearing.

pages.title: Raccoon with a Striped Tail Beside a Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: A raccoon sits beside a pumpkin in this printable coloring page, with an outlined face mask, pointed ears, front paws, and a long striped tail. The tail curves along one side of the seated body, while a tree branch, falling leaves, and broad pumpkin sections establish the autumn setting.

pages.title: Bear Reading a Book Beneath an Autumn Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A bear reads beneath an autumn tree in this printable coloring page, holding an open book with both front paws above two large hind feet. Outlined pads divide the feet into smaller sections, and maple-shaped leaves appear on the branches, in the air, and around the seated bear.

pages.title: Rabbit Beside a Pumpkin and Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A rabbit sits beside a pumpkin in this printable coloring page, with long upright ears, outlined whiskers, a small tail, and front paws resting together. Its rounded hind leg and broad foot form the seated pose, while three fallen autumn leaves spread across the open foreground.

pages.title: Kitten Resting Its Paws on a Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: A kitten rests its front paws on a pumpkin in this printable coloring page, showing pointed ears, whiskers, outlined fur stripes, and a curled tail. Both hind paws sit beside the pumpkin, and several large autumn leaves add separate shapes around the kitten's complete seated body.

pages.title: Puppy in a Scarf Beside a Fall Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: A puppy sits beside a fall pumpkin in this printable coloring page, wearing a striped scarf beneath floppy ears and a small tuft of fur. Broad outlined paws and a curved tail complete the seated figure, while the pumpkin's stem, ribbed sections, and fallen leaf provide seasonal details.

pages.title: Three Smiling Mushrooms with Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: Three smiling mushrooms fill this printable coloring page, with rounded spotted caps, broad stalks, and outlined gills above an acorn and two autumn leaves. One tall mushroom rises behind the smaller pair, leaving large open areas inside the stalks and clearly separated sections beneath each cap.

pages.title: Two Smiling Pine Cones with a Pine Sprig Coloring Page
pages.description: Two smiling pine cones appear in this printable coloring page, with one standing upright and the other lying across the foreground beside a pine sprig. Broad overlapping scales surround their outlined faces, while the sprig divides into long pointed needles that remain separate from the larger cone shapes.

pages.title: Five Geese Flying Above Autumn Trees Coloring Page
pages.description: Five geese fly above autumn trees in this printable coloring page, with long necks, outstretched wings, small tails, and two feet on each bird. One larger goose leads the group above four smaller birds, while maple-shaped leaves mark the rounded treetops along the bottom of the scene.

pages.title: Child Jumping into a Pile of Fall Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A child jumps into a leaf pile in this printable coloring page, spreading both arms while bent knees and boots descend among large autumn leaves. An open jacket and ribbed sweater collar add clothing sections, with a nearby tree, bushes, and drifting leaves defining the outdoor setting.

pages.title: Boy Raking Fall Leaves Beside a Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: A boy rakes fall leaves in this printable coloring page, holding a long handle with both hands beside a broad tree trunk and rounded bushes. The connected rake head spreads across the leaf pile, while his hooded jacket, rolled trouser cuffs, and laced shoes provide separate clothing details.

pages.title: Children Riding a Tractor Hay Wagon Coloring Page
pages.description: Two children ride a hay wagon in this printable coloring page, sitting behind a tractor driver beneath falling leaves near a barn and fence. The wagon's wooden rails, hay, wheels, and connecting hitch are clearly outlined, while foreground pumpkins add broad curved shapes below the farm scene.

pages.title: Corn Maze Path with Pumpkins at the Entrance Coloring Page
pages.description: A path curves through a corn maze in this printable coloring page, with two large pumpkins marking an entrance between tall stalks and broad leaves. Outlined ears of corn appear at several heights, and the widening foreground path leaves a clear open space beneath the surrounding rows.

pages.title: Smiling Farm Tractor Beside Harvest Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling farm tractor fills this printable coloring page, showing large outlined tires, a cab, steering wheel, curved exhaust pipe, and pumpkins beside its wheels. Broad tread sections remain open for coloring, while the front grille, round headlights, and short background fence provide smaller connected details.

pages.title: Autumn Barn with Hay Bale and Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: An autumn barn stands in this printable coloring page, with open double doors, a crossed upper window, a round hay bale, and two pumpkins. Vertical wall boards and diagonal door braces divide the building into broad sections, while a leafy tree and simple ground lines complete the setting.

pages.title: Pickup Truck Carrying Pumpkins in Fall Coloring Page
pages.description: A pickup truck carries pumpkins in this printable coloring page, parked beneath an autumn branch with large leaves scattered around its wheels and front bumper. The cab, cargo rails, round headlights, side mirror, and outlined tires give the vehicle clear sections without hiding the harvest in its open bed.

pages.title: Autumn Porch with a Wreath and Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: An autumn porch fills this printable coloring page, with a leaf wreath on the door, two pumpkins, a flower pot, and lanterns beside the entrance. A peaked roof, square columns, broad steps, and matching railings frame the arrangement, leaving large open sections across the door and porch floor.

pages.title: Cottage with a Chimney Between Autumn Trees Coloring Page
pages.description: A cottage stands between two autumn trees in this printable coloring page, with a brick chimney, curved roof tiles, an arched door, and three windows. Small entry steps lead toward scattered leaves, while the tree canopies and rounded bushes frame the complete house without obscuring its main features.

pages.title: Park Bench Beneath Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A park bench sits beneath autumn leaves in this printable coloring page, with broad wooden slats, curved armrests, four legs, and a winding path nearby. The tree arches above the empty seat, while a small leaf pile, drifting leaves, grass tufts, and rounded bushes complete the park scene.

pages.title: Autumn Window with a Mug and Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: An autumn window fills this printable coloring page, showing a steaming mug and pumpkin on the sill beneath tied curtains and a simple curtain rod. Falling leaves and a tree trunk appear through the divided panes, while the mug handle, pumpkin ribs, and broad curtain folds add distinct enclosed sections.

pages.title: Rain Boots and Umbrella with Fall Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A pair of rain boots stands beneath an umbrella in this printable coloring page, with spotted patterns, smiling faces, a curved handle, and two autumn leaves. Broad canopy panels and outlined boot soles leave clear coloring areas, while a small puddle rests between the leaves beneath the separate objects.

pages.title: Knitted Sweater and Scarf with Fall Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A knitted sweater and folded scarf fill this printable coloring page, with broad cable patterns, ribbed cuffs, a rolled collar, and three autumn leaves nearby. The sweater's two sleeves remain fully outlined, and wide stripes with short fringe sections divide the scarf below the larger garment.

pages.title: Fall Leaf Mandala with Maple Leaves and Acorns Coloring Page
pages.description: A fall leaf mandala fills this printable coloring page, arranging maple and oak leaves around an open circle with four acorns between the larger shapes. Branching veins divide the repeated leaves into broad sections, while short stems connect the radial design without adding lettering to the central space.

pages.title: Hello Fall Lettering with Leaves and a Pumpkin Coloring Page
pages.description: Hello Fall lettering fills this printable coloring page, with large hollow letters surrounded by maple and oak leaves, four acorns, and a pumpkin below. Curving outlined stems link the autumn decorations around the words, while the wide letter interiors and separate leaf veins provide larger and smaller coloring spaces.

pages.title: Three Smiling Sunflowers with Autumn Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: Three smiling sunflowers fill this printable coloring page, with broad petals, outlined seed circles, connected stems, and pointed leaves above a small autumn leaf. The tallest flower rises behind the lower pair, and the open flower centers contrast with the narrow stem sections and simple branching veins.

pages.title: Smiling Pumpkin and Two Gourds with a Leaf Coloring Page
pages.description: A smiling pumpkin and two gourds fill this printable coloring page, with a curved-neck gourd, a bumpy pear-shaped gourd, and an autumn leaf below. Long ribs follow the pumpkin and curved gourd, while outlined spots and uneven edges distinguish the smaller gourd's separate surface sections.

pages.title: Wheelbarrow Filled with Pumpkins and Leaves Coloring Page
pages.description: A wheelbarrow holds pumpkins and leaves in this printable coloring page, with one front wheel, two support legs, connected braces, and two complete handles. Its broad basin separates the harvest from the lower frame, while wheel spokes, pumpkin ribs, and branching leaf veins add smaller enclosed details.

pages.title: Autumn Fairy Holding a Leaf on a Mushroom Coloring Page
pages.description: An autumn fairy sits on a mushroom in this printable coloring page, holding a maple leaf while wearing a leaf dress and leafy head decoration. Two leaf-shaped wings extend behind her shoulders, and her long hair, bare feet, mushroom spots, and fallen leaves create clearly separated areas around the seated figure.

pages.title: Autumn Bookstore with Books and Pumpkins Coloring Page
pages.description: An autumn bookstore fills this printable coloring page, with books arranged behind a curtained display window, a scalloped awning, entry steps, and pumpkins outside. The shelves include upright volumes, displayed covers, and an open book, while falling leaves and a nearby tree frame the complete shop facade.
